title: Gypensapogenin I Ameliorates Isoproterenol (ISO)-Induced Myocardial Damage through Regulating the TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 Pathway.
authors: Li, Mengyuan; Tan, Hongyan; Gao, Ting; Han, Linlin; Teng, Xinhang; Wang, Fang; Zhang, Xiaoshu
one_liner_zh: 研究皂苷Gyp I通过TLR4/NF-kB/NLRP3通路改善心肌损伤，仅用分子对接辅助验证药物-蛋白结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Myocardial fibrosis (MF) is a common pathological feature of many heart diseases and seriously threatens the normal activity of the heart. Jiaogulan (Gynostemma pentaphyllum) tea is a functional food that is commercially available worldwide. Gypensapogenin I (Gyp I), which is a novel dammarane-type saponin, was obtained from the hydrolysates of total gypenosides. It has been reported to exert a beneficial anti-inflammatory effect. In our study, we attempted to investigate the efficiency and possible molecular mechanism of Gyp I in cardiac injury treatment induced by ISO. In vitro, Gyp I was found to increase the survival rate of H9c2 cells and inhibit apoptosis. Combined with molecular docking and Western blot analysis, Gyp I was confirmed to regulate the TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 signaling pathway. In vivo, C57BL6 mice were subcutaneously injected with 10 mg/kg ISO to induce heart failure. Mice were given a gavage of Gyp I (10, 20, or 40 mg/kg/d for three weeks). Pathological alterations, fibrosis-, inflammation-, and apoptosis-related molecules were examined. By means of cardiac function detection, biochemical index analysis, QRT-PCR monitoring, histopathological staining, immunohistochemistry, and Western blot analysis, it was elucidated that Gyp I could improve cardiac dysfunction, alleviate collagen deposition, and reduce myocardial fibrosis (MF). In summary, we reported for the first time that Gyp I showed good myocardial protective activity in vitro and in vivo, and its mechanism was related to the TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 心肌纤维化（MF）是许多心脏疾病的常见病理特征，严重威胁心脏的正常活动。绞股蓝（Gynostemma pentaphyllum）茶是一种全球市售的功能性食品。绞股蓝皂苷元I（Gyp I）是一种新型达玛烷型皂苷，从总绞股蓝皂苷的水解产物中获得，据报道具有有益的抗炎作用。在本研究中，我们试图探讨Gyp I在ISO诱导的心脏损伤治疗中的效果及可能的分子机制。体外实验中，发现Gyp I能提高H9c2细胞的存活率并抑制凋亡。结合分子对接和Western blot分析，确认Gyp I调节TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3信号通路。体内实验中，C57BL6小鼠皮下注射10 mg/kg ISO以诱导心力衰竭，并给予Gyp I灌胃（10、20或40 mg/kg/天，持续三周）。检测了病理改变、纤维化、炎症和凋亡相关分子。通过心功能检测、生化指标分析、QRT-PCR监测、组织病理学染色、免疫组织化学和Western blot分析，阐明Gyp I能改善心脏功能障碍、减轻胶原沉积并减少心肌纤维化（MF）。总之，我们首次报道Gyp I在体外和体内均表现出良好的心肌保护活性，其机制与TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3信号通路相关。
